summary: Clears an 8x8 grid matrix stored inside the owner object. Each cell is a dword at a stride of 9 dwords (first cell at this + 0x4), so the clear covers 64 cells; afterwards the cell counter at this[577] (byte offset 0x904) is reset to 0. Runs per-frame on the frame path via caller LoopWithConditionalSkipFunction (0x00410980).

operations.description: Initialize the matrix walk pointer to this + 1 (byte offset 0x4), the first grid cell entry.
Outer loop over 8 rows using a countdown counter seeded from 8.
Inner loop over 8 columns per row using a countdown counter seeded from 8.
Write 0 to the current grid cell (the strided entry beginning at this + 0x4).
Advance the cell pointer by 9 dwords (stride 9) to reach the next column cell.
Reset the cell count at this[577] (byte offset 0x904) to 0.
Invoked per-frame by LoopWithConditionalSkipFunction (0x00410980) to clear the matrix on the frame path.

unresolved: Why the 8x8 grid uses a stride of 9 dwords (one extra dword per row) is unresolved from this packet.
Owner class is unknown; the caller LoopWithConditionalSkipFunction (0x00410980) supplies the this pointer on the frame path.
